target: Main-paper writing represented by the fixed target LaTeX snapshot within physical target PDF pages 1 through min(9, total_pages).
aggregation: Overall Writing Quality is a direct judgment. Do not calculate an average or weighted total, or cap it using auxiliary findings.
shared_rules: Apply the same five anchors to humans and models evaluating the same target snapshot and page window. Record their reading representations and any supporting-material use.

Count physical PDF pages starting at one, not printed proceedings page numbers. Review pages 1 through min(9, total_pages). Score main-paper writing only, including its title, abstract and in-scope technical explanations.

References and appendices are supporting material, even when visible inside the window. Later pages and the full appendix may be consulted to understand a dependency, but their writing is not included in core scores and reading all of them is not required.

The deliberate page-nine cutoff is an assessment boundary. Do not penalize a paragraph, formula or table continuing later, a conclusion outside the window, or details reasonably deferred to an appendix. Judge observed organization and explanation within the window, not whole-paper completeness.
Normal stylistic variation and minor copyediting preferences do not prevent a 5. Do not force a balanced score distribution.
Evaluate communication, not novelty, acceptance merit, external factual truth, scientific correctness, source-code elegance, image aesthetics or preferred typesetting.
Do not demand a fixed section order, experiment, figure, table or equation. Technical expression also covers concepts, methods and analysis; all five dimensions apply and there is no core N/A.

Use uncertain for a dimension when unreadable or unavailable evidence prevents a defensible judgment. Missing input evidence is not a low-quality manuscript. A planned scope boundary alone does not require uncertain.

Distinguish confirmed defects in active in-scope source from unsupported preprocessing, compile/render errors and unplanned request truncation. Do not treat comments or inactive source branches as manuscript text.

Use same-snapshot LaTeX for wording, notation and source-readable content, and rendered pages for figures and reading context. Do not claim to see unsupplied pixels. Report source/PDF inconsistencies without guessing or silently repairing the target.
PDF visual integrity is a separate auxiliary score limited to inspected pages. Conference-version differences are a separate audit. Neither automatically lowers or caps core scores.

Judge Overall directly, not as an average or weighted sum. If the complete declared primary window was not received or reviewed, return an incomplete run with uncertain core scores; do not claim a completed whole-window assessment.

dimensions.label: Language Clarity & Fluency
dimensions.definition: Assess sentence-level comprehensibility, wording, grammar and terminology in the in-scope main-paper writing. Scientific truth and preference for a particular English style are outside this dimension.

scale.1: Most of the relevant prose is unintelligible or too ambiguous to recover its meaning.
scale.2: Frequent severe wording or grammatical problems obscure important meanings across substantial passages.
scale.3: Recurring unclear, ambiguous or awkward passages require substantial rereading or reader reconstruction, although the main meanings can be recovered.
scale.4: A few localized wording, grammar or terminology problems require minor clarification; the main meanings remain readily understandable.
scale.5: The prose is clear and fluent, with sufficiently precise wording for its purpose. Harmless stylistic differences or minor copyediting preferences do not reduce this score.

dimensions.definition_zh: 评价评分窗口内正文句子的可理解性、措辞、语法与术语；不评价科学事实真伪，也不因英文风格偏好扣分。

scale_zh.1: 大部分相关文字无法理解，或含义模糊到难以还原。
scale_zh.2: 频繁且严重的措辞或语法问题，遮蔽多个重要段落的含义。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现含混或不自然的表述，需明显重读或推断，但主要含义仍可还原。
scale_zh.4: 少量局部措辞、语法或术语问题需要澄清，主要含义仍易于理解。
scale_zh.5: 表达清楚、流畅，措辞足以准确传达目的；无碍理解的风格差异或轻微润色偏好不扣分。

dimensions.label: Coherence & Logical Flow
dimensions.definition: Assess connections among sentences, paragraphs, sections, claims and explanations within the scored main-paper window. Do not count the planned page cutoff as a logical gap or judge scientific truth.

scale.1: The manuscript lacks a recoverable main line of exposition; most connections cannot be followed.
scale.2: Major disconnections, unexplained jumps or internal contradictions block understanding of important parts of the exposition.
scale.3: Repeated weak transitions, unexplained dependencies, repetition or inconsistent exposition require the reader to reconstruct important connections.
scale.4: The exposition is followable, with a few local jumps, repetitions or weak transitions that need minor revision.
scale.5: Ideas and supporting explanations progress coherently; the reader can follow the main line without supplying missing connections.

dimensions.definition_zh: 评价评分窗口内句段、章节、论点和解释的衔接；页数边界不算逻辑断裂，也不判断科学结论真伪。

scale_zh.1: 缺少可还原的主要论述线索，大部分联系无法跟随。
scale_zh.2: 严重脱节、无解释跳跃或内部矛盾妨碍理解重要论述。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现衔接不足、悬空依赖、重复或表述不一致，需要读者重建重要联系。
scale_zh.4: 论述可以跟随，存在少量局部跳跃、重复或衔接不足，需要轻微修订。
scale_zh.5: 思想与支撑解释展开连贯，读者无需自行补足缺失联系即可跟随主线。

dimensions.label: Structural Completeness
dimensions.definition: Assess organization and narrative completeness within the observed main-paper window, relative to paper type and stated aims. Exclude the deliberate page-nine cutoff, out-of-window sections and reasonable appendix deferral from missing-content penalties. This is not whole-paper or conference-version coverage.

scale.1: Most essential narrative content within the scored window is demonstrably absent, replaced by placeholders or too fragmented to recover; the planned cutoff is excluded.
scale.2: Major confirmed omissions or unfinished passages within the scored window prevent understanding of important in-scope exposition; the planned cutoff and reasonable appendix deferral are excluded.
scale.3: Several substantive in-scope narrative gaps or unexplained dependencies require reconstruction, although the central observed account can be followed.
scale.4: The observed in-scope account is organized and substantially complete; a few local omissions or organizational gaps need minor clarification.
scale.5: The observed main-paper window is navigable and sufficiently complete for what it presents, without material narrative gaps. Continuation beyond the window or valid appendix deferral does not reduce this score.

dimensions.definition_zh: 相对于论文类型和目的，评价已观察正文窗口内的组织与叙述完整性。第9页截断、窗口外章节及合理放入附录的细节不算缺失；不评价全文或会议版覆盖率。

scale_zh.1: 窗口内关键叙述大部分已证实缺失、仍是占位内容或严重破碎；不计预设截断。
scale_zh.2: 窗口内重要叙述已证实遗漏或未完成，妨碍理解；不计页数边界或合理的附录承接。
scale_zh.3: 窗口内存在多个实质叙述缺口或悬空依赖，需读者重建，但仍可跟随已观察主线。
scale_zh.4: 已观察范围内论述有组织且基本完整，少量局部遗漏或组织缺口需澄清。
scale_zh.5: 已观察正文窗口清楚可定位，所呈现论述足够完整，无实质叙述缺口；窗口外续写或合理附录承接不扣分。

dimensions.label: Technical Expression & Referential Clarity
dimensions.definition: Assess in-scope definitions, concepts, symbols, methods, steps, mathematical explanations, tables, captions and explanatory links, using the supplied same-source pages and optional supporting appendix. Judge technical communication, not image aesthetics or scientific correctness; auxiliary appendix writing is not itself scored.

scale.1: Most of the essential technical account cannot be interpreted because its expressions, definitions or referential links are missing or uninterpretable.
scale.2: Major undefined concepts or symbols, ambiguous steps or broken explanatory dependencies prevent understanding of important technical content.
scale.3: Recurring insufficient definitions, ambiguous notation, unclear captions or unexplained links require substantial reader inference.
scale.4: The key technical account is understandable; a few local definitions, explanations or referential links need clarification.
scale.5: Technical concepts and relevant expressions are sufficiently defined and explained; the supplied methods, notation and referential links support clear understanding within the declared scope.

dimensions.label_zh: 技术表达与引用指向清晰度
dimensions.definition_zh: 结合同源页面及按需查阅的辅助附录，评价窗口内概念、定义、符号、方法步骤、公式、表格、图注与指向解释；不评价图片美观或科学正确性，附录本身不计分。

scale_zh.1: 大部分必要技术内容因表达、定义或指向联系缺失或不可解读而无法理解。
scale_zh.2: 重要概念或符号未定义、步骤含混或解释依赖断裂，妨碍理解关键技术内容。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现定义不足、符号含混、说明不清或关联未解释，需要大量读者推断。
scale_zh.4: 关键技术论述可以理解，少量局部定义、解释或指向联系需要澄清。
scale_zh.5: 技术概念及相关表达定义和说明充分，已提供的方法、符号及指向联系支持理解声明范围内的内容。

dimensions.label: Overall Writing Quality
dimensions.definition: Directly judge how clear, coherent and sufficiently complete the main-paper writing is within the scored page window. Do not infer whole-paper quality, average component scores, penalize the planned cutoff or require novelty, perfect rendering or conference-version agreement.

scale.1: The manuscript is largely unusable as an understandable scientific account because of pervasive writing or confirmed content-completeness problems.
scale.2: Serious writing or content-completeness problems require substantial rewriting or restoration before the main account is understandable.
scale.3: The main account is usable, but noticeable writing or narrative problems require substantial reader reconstruction or meaningful revision.
scale.4: The manuscript is clear and usable overall, with localized writing issues needing minor revision.
scale.5: The observed main-paper writing communicates a clear, coherent and sufficiently complete account within the scored window. Minor stylistic preferences and the planned cutoff do not reduce this score.

dimensions.definition_zh: 直接判断评分窗口内正文表达是否清楚、连贯且足够完整；不推断全文质量，不计算分项平均，不因预设截断扣分，也不要求创新性、完美排版或会议版本一致。

scale_zh.1: 普遍的写作问题或已证实的内容缺失，使论文大部分无法作为可理解的科学论述使用。
scale_zh.2: 严重写作或内容完整性问题，需要大量重写或恢复，才能理解主要论述。
scale_zh.3: 主要论述基本可用，但明显写作或叙述问题需要读者大量推断或进行实质修订。
scale_zh.4: 论文总体清楚可用，局部写作问题需要轻微修订。
scale_zh.5: 评分窗口内正文传达清楚、连贯且足够完整的论述；轻微风格偏好和预设页数边界不扣分。

auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.requires: Actual observation of the target rendered PDF pages, identified by PDF hash and inspected page IDs.

scale.1: Most displayed content cannot be read normally.
scale.2: Multiple important displayed parts are difficult or impossible to read.
scale.3: Localized rendering defects impede reading of some displayed content.
scale.4: Minor visual defects do not materially impede reading.
scale.5: The inspected target PDF is visually intact and legible.

auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.source_only_rule: Return not_assessed with a null score and no issue codes; do not infer rendering quality from LaTeX.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.core_interpretation: If display defects block a human core judgment, consult a readable same-source representation; otherwise mark the affected core judgment uncertain rather than penalizing source writing.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.label: PDF Visual Integrity & Legibility
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.label_zh: PDF 视觉完整性与可读性
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.definition: Optional: rate only the inspected target PDF pages, not the uninspected full file. This does not contribute to writing scores or completion.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.definition_zh: 选填：仅评价实际检查的目标 PDF 页面，不推断未检查的全文；不计入写作评分或完成条件。

scale_zh.1: 大部分显示内容无法正常阅读。
scale_zh.2: 多处重要显示内容难以或无法阅读。
scale_zh.3: 局部渲染缺陷影响部分内容阅读。
scale_zh.4: 轻微视觉缺陷，不明显影响阅读。
scale_zh.5: 检查的目标 PDF 视觉完整、清晰可读。

title.zh: 正文写作质量 · 前至多9页

scope.en: Score main-paper writing on physical PDF pages 1–9, or all pages if shorter. The complete appendix is available only as auxiliary reference.
scope.zh: 核心评分针对目标 PDF 第1–9个物理页面中的正文；不足9页则全部提供。完整附录可浏览，仅作辅助参考。

version_difference_flags.label: Methods, experiments, results or conclusions differ
version_difference_flags.label_zh: 方法、实验、结果或结论不同

scope_policy.primary: Main-paper writing visible within physical PDF pages 1 through min(9, total_pages), including title, abstract, prose, in-scope technical material and captions.
scope_policy.supporting: The full target PDF and appendix remain available as auxiliary reference. References and appendices, even within the first nine pages, are not core-scored. Later main-paper pages are also outside core scoring.
scope_policy.boundary_rule: The planned page-window cutoff is not a manuscript defect or a failed transport. Do not penalize continuation beyond page nine, a missing out-of-window conclusion, or reasonable appendix deferral.
scope_policy.completion: Review the assigned page window, not the full appendix. Unplanned missing pages, unreadable evidence or request truncation remain input failures.
